description: Modular printed electronics installation reference for a Ø90/86 mm tube, using separately identified supplier units.
releaseRequirements: Qualify a separate metal/tube recovery attachment for the actual deployment speed, opening history and landing impact; the printed electronics sled has no parachute load rating.
Measure the actual D16T tube bore and available length; confirm its condition and delivered properties, all board interfaces, battery retention, connectors, wiring and printed fits.
Verify the deliberately drilled Grandado posts, through-screw head seats, 10 mm couplers and thread engagement. The service covers have no qualified seal or IP rating.
Identify the ELRS receiver and antenna. The user-provided dimensions define fitting references for the integral lid tie saddles only.
Use TPU 95A and qualify the actual grade's stiffness, travel, damping, creep, temperature, NVMe retention and Pi cooling on a representative instrumented prototype.
Define CO2 discharge pressure, temperature, jet direction, separation and venting; the integrated rear closure and separate TPU buffer have open cable channels and are not a pressure seal.
